verdict.rationale: Raygun ships an AI Resolution chat that users can talk to in natural language, but it is scoped to diagnosing and fixing individual errors rather than operating the product. An official MCP server also exists, which could let AI clients drive Raygun through natural language, but the evidence says nothing about which operations it exposes. Missing for 10: documented natural-language control of product actions (e.g., resolving or ignoring errors, filtering, configuring), details of the MCP server's capabilities, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: You can chat with this tool collaboratively.
This feature allows you to identify and tackle errors swiftly with just a click, using advanced AI technology powered by OpenAI and Azure OpenAI.
